'''Enkephalin''' was a type of medicine used during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]] administered it to a burn patient from an industrial [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] plant.<ref name="MedStar II" />
